title: Never enable Cloudflare Web Analytics from the Pages dashboard; add the beacon by hand in BOTH landing files
body:
Enabling Web Analytics in the Pages dashboard injects the beacon into the WHOLE site on the next deploy, `/cv` and `/en/cv` included. Those pages must stay at zero JS because Browser Rendering prints the published page for the PDF (waits on networkidle), so a script there silently changes production PDFs. `no-client-js.check.ts` cannot see it: it reads `dist/`, and the injection happens at the edge. Only `scripts/served.check.ts` (from smoke-deploy.yml) would catch it, after the fact.
Instead, the beacon (`PUBLIC_CF_BEACON_TOKEN`) and Clarity (`PUBLIC_CLARITY_ID`) are wired by hand in `src/pages/index.astro` AND `src/pages/en/index.astro` — never in `src/layouts/Base.astro`, which /cv uses. Any new analytics/tag goes into both landing files, and the CSP in `public/_headers` must allow its origins.
not_derivable: The dashboard toggle is outside the repo; the code only shows the manual wiring, not why the toggle must stay off.

evidence.summary: Header comment: dashboard Web Analytics injects into the whole site; ANALYTICS_FINGERPRINTS.
